ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Child Process Created as System
ruleDefinitions.description: Detection of child processes spawned with SYSTEM privileges by parents with LOCAL SERVICE or NETWORK SERVICE accounts

sequences.query: ((parent_process_user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR parent_process_user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*")) AND (parent_process_user = RGX("\\\\NETWORK\\ SERVICE$") OR parent_process_user = RGX("\\\\LOCAL\\ SERVICE$")) AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*")) AND (user = RGX("\\\\SYSTEM$") OR user = RGX("\\\\Système$") OR user = RGX("\\\\СИСТЕМА$")) AND (process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*DavSetCookie.*")))
